description: This file implements a React component 'LinkElement' and related UI logic for rendering, editing, and managing hyperlink elements within a Slate.js-based rich text editor. It includes UI controls for editing, unlinking, and previewing links, along with dialog components for input.

methods.name: LinkElement
methods.description: React component for rendering and editing a link element within the editor, including UI controls for editing, unlinking, and opening React modals/dialogs.

methods.name: LinkDialog
methods.description: Component rendering a dialog for editing or creating link URLs.

methods.name: linkButton
methods.description: A tooltip-wrapped button component to trigger the link wrapping action in the editor.
